start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj animals mein respiration dekhenge. Aapka din kaisa ja raha hai?

turns.line: बिना ऑक्सीजन के जी नहीं सकते
turns.reply: Bilkul, bina oxygen ke jeena mushkil hai—isko lesson ke ant mein phir jodenge. Daudne ke baad saans tez kyun hoti hai, aap kya sochenge?
